secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web app config (Firebase console -> Project settings -> Your apps -> Web app). Enables admin login, Firestore content and Storage uploads.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Supabase dashboard -> Project settings -> API). Used for public image storage and shared content sync.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon browser key (Supabase dashboard -> Project settings -> API). Never a service_role key.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Supabase Storage bucket name for media uploads (defaults to 'media').
